GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.

2. When practising Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.

3. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Good night
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Thank you

4. When practising Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.

5. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.

6. When practising Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.

7. When practising Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading.

8. When practising Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.

9. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Haus
   C. Buch
   D. Wasser

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.

11. When practising Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing.

12. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 3.3.3 Functional Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 3.4.3 Adverbs, Verbs and Conjunctions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Listening for gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.2 Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.3.3: Functional writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 4.4.4 Accusative and Dative Case ● Definite, indefinite and negative art and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.2 Scanning, Reading and Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
